title: Add reusable bounded report bundles for migration of multi-section outputs
description: Implement generic ordered multi-section preview and Excel/PDF output over existing authorized private/shared report definitions and pinned published versions, to enable existing customer packets and document outputs to migrate without dedicated exporters. Stateless bundle request references existing definition IDs/versions; no new entities or database schema. Keep legacy packet/document routes and their specialized layouts until genuine parity is proven. This increment adds reusable capability, not an individual customer-packet report. Stage 2 only; no dedicated business-report controller/designer/exporter, arbitrary SQL, schema/migrations/production operations, secrets/env edits, permission expansion or unrelated changes. Preserve old entries until every migration has genuine parity acceptance. Tests may write only guarded (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance / NEWERP_AUTOTEST_* databases.
acceptance_criteria: Users can select an ordered bounded list of existing definitions/versions in the generic report configuration UI and preview named sections using existing IReportConfigurationExecutionService. Validate 1-8 sections, finite IDs/versions, bounded per-section pages and total rows; no arbitrary SQL, joins, cross-dataset arithmetic or new report-specific query logic.

Revalidate each definition sharing/version access plus current menu/row/column/data scope on every request. Load all authorized validated sections before producing any output; one denied/revoked/invalid section fails the entire bundle without partial data or downloads. Preserve independent currency/unit/grain/evidence and existing query/audit boundaries.

Provide one generic multi-sheet Excel and one multi-section PDF with safe stable section titles, field order, numeric/null semantics, formulas escaped, readable headings/page boundaries and provenance. Reuse existing generic exporters and PDF infrastructure; do not mark old packet/document parity from bundle availability or switch old routes.

Test at least two different authorized datasets together, pinned/shared versions, empty sections, denial/revocation of one section, count/row/byte limits, Excel sheet semantics and PDF content. Add guarded isolated SQL fixtures, run related tests, safe Release build/unit suite and scheduler self-test/contracts; actual browser download compatibility remains genuinely tested or explicitly unverified.
implementation_evidence: Existing generic execution interface only previews one definition; Excel/PDF exporters accept one preview. CustomerReportPacketController composes sales/receivable sections with dedicated outputs, TradeDocumentController print/export has document layout. Current generic UI and task history have no reusable bounded multi-section definition-reference bundle; this is prerequisite shared platform capability for those migration categories, not an old-route switch.
